en.quote: Our market capitalization will reach $1 trillion, and we will become the world’s largest company.
en.head: Gazprom’s market value remained far below $1 trillion.
en.body: Miller gave a seven-to-ten-year horizon. Gazprom’s report put market capitalization at $53.11 billion on December 31, 2017, nine and a half years after the forecast, and at $52.3 billion at the end of 2018. Both dated snapshots are far below the stated $1 trillion; market value fluctuated between them.

osrc.t: Gazprom annual report, market capitalization at end-2018
